supportManagerSetupQ1: How do I finish setting up my business?
supportManagerSetupA1: Work through the setup steps from your dashboard. You can leave and come back at any point — your progress is saved as you go.
supportManagerSetupQ2: Why is my kitchen licence under review?
supportManagerSetupA2: Every licence is checked before a kitchen goes live. You will get an email the moment it is approved, usually within 2 business days.
supportManagerSetupA3: As soon as your licence is approved and your kitchen has availability set. You will be notified by email.
supportManagerKitchensQ1: How do I add another kitchen?
supportManagerKitchensA1: Open My Kitchens from your dashboard. You can create as many kitchens as your location supports, each with its own rates and availability.
supportManagerKitchensQ2: How do I set my cancellation and notice rules?
supportManagerKitchensA2: Booking Policies holds your cancellation windows, notice periods and other booking rules. Check-in and check-out timing lives in its own page.
supportManagerKitchensQ3: What is the difference between availability and rates?
supportManagerKitchensA3: Availability decides when chefs can book you. Your hourly and daily rates, plus minimum booking hours, are set per kitchen.
supportManagerApplicationsA1: The documents and questions a chef must satisfy before they can book your kitchen. You control these per location.
supportManagerApplicationsQ2: What is the difference between the two tiers?
supportManagerApplicationsA2: Local Cooks reviews the initial request. You set the kitchen access requirements, which chefs complete after initial approval.
supportManagerBookingsQ1: How do I approve a booking?
supportManagerBookingsA1: Open Bookings, review the request, and approve or decline it. You will be emailed about new requests.
supportManagerBookingsQ2: How does check-in and check-out work?
supportManagerBookingsA2: Set your check-in window and no-show grace in Check-in and Check-out, then record arrivals from the booking itself.
supportManagerBookingsA3: Raise a damage claim from the booking. Claims and overstay penalties are tracked together in the resolution center.
supportManagerPaymentsA1: Connect Stripe in Payment Setup. Payouts usually arrive within 2–3 business days of a completed booking.
supportManagerPaymentsA2: Your hourly and daily rates, plus any storage or equipment the chef books. Revenue is broken down in the Revenue tab.
